correctness.rationale: A sum containing 1 is uniquely 1+b, b in the alternating basis. A carry/digit-color split shows odd-supported b belongs to E_1 iff some digit is at least 2; even-supported b yields exactly 2, 3, and 1+g^{2j}, with g=3 boundary handled separately. These disjoint sets count g^k-2^k+k+1. Exhaustive independent unordered-pair enumeration for g in {3,4,5}, k in {1,2,3}, and g=6,k in {1,2} agreed pointwise. Infinite proof uses digit lemmas, not the finite tests.
